description: This Java class defines the SearchNamespaceResultEntry, a data model representing the number of Things associated with a namespace within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing instances from JSON strings or objects, serializing to JSON, and standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: SearchNamespaceResultEntry
classes.description: Immutable class representing an entry that contains a namespace and its associated count of Things, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and equality checks.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SearchNamespaceResultEntry instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the instance into a JsonObject, optionally applying a predicate to filter fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on namespace and count.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash based on namespace and count.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of Things for this namespace.

methods.name: getSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema version field definition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
